description: DHT22 / AM2302 on PB12 (open drain, module pull-up) read every 2.5 s with DWT->CYCCNT microsecond timing: start pulse, answer, 40 bits, checksum; prints RH and T on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. PB12 open-drain output idling released (the module's 10 kOhm pull-up holds DATA high; PB12 is 5 V tolerant), DWT->CYCCNT enabled for microsecond timing. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'DHT22 on PB12 (DWT timing)
'. 2.5 s after boot and then every 2.5 s: PB12 low for 1.2 ms (host start), released; with interrupts masked the firmware waits <= 200 us for the sensor's answer (none -> 'DHT22: no response
'), its 80 us low / 80 us high, then times the high phase of each of the 40 bits (> 40 us = 1); a missing edge prints 'DHT22: timeout in bit <n>
', a wrong sum 'DHT22: checksum error
', otherwise 'RH=<%>.<d> T=[-]<C>.<d>
' with RH = (b0 << 8 | b1) / 10 and T = ((b2 & 0x7F) << 8 | b3) / 10, negative when b2 bit 7 is set. The DHT22 sends the measurement it took after the PREVIOUS read, so a change shows up one read later.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no DHT22 on PB12 (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires a DHT22 module instead)
